Name: Johannes Müller

Work Experience:
- 2023--2023: Software Engineering Intern, Siemens AG. Collaborated with a cross-functional team to develop a web-based dashboard for monitoring industrial IoT devices. Assisted in optimizing database queries, resulting in a 30% improvement in system performance. Participated in daily stand-up meetings and contributed ideas for improving the agile development process. Documented technical specifications and provided training sessions for new interns joining the project.
- 2022--2022: Machine Learning Intern, Fraunhofer Institute for Intelligent Analysis and Information Systems (IAIS). Designed and implemented machine learning models for image classification tasks using TensorFlow and Keras. Conducted data preprocessing, feature engineering
